fusions.name: Clod Toss
fusions.desc: Flings a clod of earth that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles.

fusions.name: Spadeful Spray
fusions.desc: Flings 3 clods at once, spread apart, each dealing 5 earth damage and knocking the target back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Earthwork
fusions.desc: Raises a wall of packed earth 4 tiles long ahead of you for 8 seconds that enemies cannot cross.

fusions.name: Compacted Layers
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: your damage rises 4% per stack (22% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
